lines.text: Section 5.10 Owner and Developer desire that construction of the Townhouse
Building can proceed expeditiously. Accordingly, Developer hereby grants to Owner a
temporary license to (a) install or place any tell-tale crack monitors, survey prisms,
vibration monitors, or similar protective equipment on or within the Developer's Property
as required by law or as reasonably requested by either party and (b) to monitor and
maintain the foregoing in good condition, as is reasonably required for the safe and
efficient construction of the Townhouse Building and the protection of the Developer
Property (the“Owner Access License") provided, however, that nothing contained in
this Agreement shall be construed to permit the placement by Owner of any equipment or
materials, including without limitation temporary construction equipment, on the roof or
any other portion of the Developer's Property or the Easement Area.
Section 5.11 Developer shall not object to, obstruct, or interfere with Owner's
exercise of its rights under Section 5.10, above. Owner agrees to perform the Owner's
Construction Work:
(a) In accordance with all applicable legal requirements (including, without
limitation, the obtaining of and compliance with all required permits and other
governmental and quasi-governmental approvals and compliance with all
governmental and quasi-govermmental requirements);
(b) In a prompt, safe and efficient manner; and
(c) In accordance with good construction practices and in a customary manner for
such work.
Section 5.12 In the event that any work by Owner, in connection with
construction of the Townhouse Building (“Owner's Construction Work") shall result in
the placing of a violation upon the Developer's Property, Owner shall, at Owner's cost
and expense, be solely responsible for curing same and shall promptly take all steps to
cure such violations of record. In the event that said violations have not been discharged
or record within thirty (30) days, or any shorter period of time required by law or the
terms of any mortgage on the Developer's Property after receiving notice of same from
Developer, Developer may, upon the giving of ten (10) days' prior written notice to
Owner, proceed to cure such violations at Owner's expense.
Section 5.13 If Developer is compelled or elects to expend any sum of money or
do any acts which require the payment of money by reason of complying with,
remedying or curing a violation on the Developer's Property that is caused by Owner's
Construction Work, Owner shall, upon demand, promptly reimburse Developer all such
sums such expenditure. Such expenses shall be limited to reasonable and customary
third-party expenses which are necessary to cure such violations.
Section 5.14 The grant of the Owner Access License hereunder is temporary
only and shall endure for only so long as is reasonably necessary to substantially
complete the construction of the Townhouse Building, and in no event shall the Owner
